svg.title: LegalRAG Explore · system architecture
svg.text: Defaults from legalrag/prompts/explore_policy.yaml, legalrag/core/config.py, .env.example and scripts/. Numbers are per question unless marked.
OFFLINE · build the index once · scripts/ingest_canlegal.py
ONLINE · one exploration per question · legalrag/explore/engine.py
one INFO line per step / LLM call
Formulate · rewrite the question for search
LLM failure → search with the raw question
Embed the rewrite, kNN over 62,942 chunks (1,024 chars each)
Filter: jurisdiction in {user's province, federal, unknown}
< 8 hits → drop the filter ("relaxed") · hybrid / BM25 optional
Score = P("yes") for "does this passage help answer the query?"
Kept passages → evidence e1…e20, plus q = the question
Built-in views · case landscape + case timeline
Group the 20 passages by document, jurisdiction, court, year
→ Sources and Timeline tabs, ~37 s after the question on a laptop
Shared prompt: question + profile (audience, goal hint,
after the plan · 180 s limit each
Grounding · every item must cite evidence
Ids not in {q, e1…e20} are stripped; items left with none are hidden
Each view carries an audit: backed / unbacked / ids removed
Streams an answer from all 20 passages + last 8 turns; cites [eN]
query vector, must match the index
Lab vLLM: whole run ~58 s, each LLM view ~8 s
M2 laptop: reranker ~45 s · Ollama run ~11 min
